description: Construction kit model for the OctoMesh AI Adapter. Defines configuration, runtime, stream and ephemeral types that back the agent-based engineering features. All AI Adapter persistence flows through these CK types - no ad-hoc MongoDB collections. Major version 3 replaced the deprecated 2.x prototype types with the agent-engineering schema documented in docs/concepts/octo-ai-adapter.md. Major version 4 carries no schema change of its own - it exists only because the System.Communication dependency moved to its 4.x major (Pool renamed to DeploymentSite, AB#4924), which ck-semver-rules.md classifies as transitively breaking. Minor 4.12.0 (AB#8453) adds the agent runtime core (Agent, Mandate, AgentTrigger, Run, ActionRecord); minor 4.13.0 (AB#9729) restricts writes of AgentTrigger, Run and ActionRecord to the agent API. Placement decision - the agent types live in System.Ai, not in a separate System.Agents model - System.Ai is already service-managed by the AI service and switched on by EnableAi, and a second model would add a second enable step and a second dependency chain without any isolation gain.
